# Ewaste Kochi — llms.txt

This is a pointer, not the served file. The real, live `llms.txt` is generated
from `src/data/routes.ts` at build time (see `scripts/gen-llms-full.ts`) and
served from `public/llms.txt` at:

https://www.ewastekochi.com/llms.txt

Edit `public/llms.txt` (or the route registry that generates it), never this
file directly — this copy exists only so the file is visible from the GitHub
repo browser and is not kept in sync automatically.
